name: DisclosureButton
purpose: Expand or collapse control on a parent task row, placed left of the subtask counter. Box 18px (not an IconButton size), icon 16px, weight 300. Kept separate from IconButton because it is a disclosure (aria-expanded) that rotates rather than a push action. Collapsed: always visible, not rotated. Expanded: rotated -90, transition-transform 100ms, visible on row hover (and on keyboard focus within the row). Hidden when the row has no visible children (for example while searching).
base: Radix Collapsible trigger (shadcn Collapsible), rendered as a button; styled with IconButton's base button classes

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the row's subtasks are shown. Rotates the chevron -90 with a 100ms transition when true.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Toggles the row in the collapsed set.

props.name: hidden
props.description: True when the row has no visible children; the control is not rendered.

states: expanded (rotated -90, visible on row hover and keyboard focus within the row)
keyboard: Tab focuses it. Enter and Space toggle it. Click and double-click stop propagation so the row does not open. It stops propagation itself; callers do not need to.
open: 1) The catalogue merges a bare chevron icon row at the same position; it is unconfirmed whether that icon is also a toggle. 2) The expanded chevron's keyboard reveal: this design shows it on focus within the row; confirm. 3) The 18px box is below the 24px target size; add hit-area padding and confirm.
